text:
alex kim: kicking off graft merge for customer Zeppelin — merging their LoRA into pegasus-13b-vanilla, running quick eval pack now. will post failures.

alex kim: run cmd: `./quick_eval --base pegasus-13b --lora zeppelin_v1.safetensors --quant 4bit --prompts quick_invoice.json --out tmp/zepp_run`

mira sood: good call. include the currency edge cases set (invoice_amounts_extended.json) — saw weird rounding before.

jamal h: FYI last time we saw token id mismatch for the customer's custom tokens (SKU/INV macros). had to remap tokenizer merges.

ciara (eval-bot): run started (id=run-2024-11-12-17-4321). smoke tests: 0/4 complete yet. posting logs to tmp/zepp_run/logs.txt

alex kim: first quickpass done: 3/7 tests failing. main failure is numeric formatting and missing leading `#INV` token in outputs. pasted sample: `expected: "#INV-12345"  got: "INV-12345"`

mira sood: hmm — that suggests the LoRA changed tokenization of the `#` prefix or we lost a special token mapping during merge. did the tokenizer merge stage run?

alex kim: merge step used our default `merge_lora.py --auto-token-merge` (no errors). log snippet: `WARN: token id conflict: '#INV' -> existing id 50213, aliased to 32104`

jamal h: can you paste the token id diff? small script I use: `python -c "import json;print(json.load(open('tmp/zepp_run/token_diff.json'))[:10])"`

alex kim: token_diff excerpt: `['#INV': 50213 -> 32104, 'CUR$': 60211 -> 60211 (ok), 'SKU#': 70001 -> 42001]`

mira sood: that `#INV` remap is the culprit. customer training used `#INV` as atomic token. when it got aliased we produce `'#' + 'INV'` instead of single token.

jamal h: quick fix: add a vocab remap that forces `#INV` to a stable id pre-merge. simplest patch: `vocab_patch = {'#INV': 50213}` then re-run merge with `--vocab-patch vocab_patch.json`. Also re-run the quant step with `--preserve-special` to avoid pruning that id.

alex kim: applying patch now. re-run command: `./quick_eval --base pegasus-13b --lora zeppelin_v1.safetensors --vocab-patch zep_patch.json --quant 4bit --preserve-special --prompts quick_invoice.json`

infra-bot: note — gpu queue ETA ~4m, job queued on p-prod-gpu-2.

ciara (eval-bot): re-run complete (id=run-2024-11-12-17-4821). smoke pack results: 6/7 pass, invoice tokens fixed :white_check_mark:. Metrics: BLEU delta -0.4, hallucination rate down from 6.8% -> 3.1, amount rounding errors dropped 78%. detailed report uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/zepp/quickpack/run-1748604821/report.html

mira sood: nice. can we add a tiny regression test to catch token-id aliasing in CI? maybe a quick token-stability assertion that runs on every LoRA merge.

jamal h: agree. I have a small patch that errors if any special token in the customer's training set is remapped to a different id post-merge. will open PR in a minute.

alex kim: thanks — I'll inform customer ops and schedule a canary with dedicated serving to validate in-prod traffic (will use prefix caching disabled to watch raw outputs). cc @mira sood for follow-up on test additions. :thumbsup:

ciara (eval-bot): advisory: quant profile shows slight CPU decode cost increase for 4-bit path on long-context (>2048) — recommend scheduling dedicated perf run if customer uses long docs.

alex kim: noted. we'll flag for dedicated perf next week. closing this quickpack — saving artifacts and marking thread resolved.

mira sood: thanks all — nice quick turnaround.
